reconciledFindings.requirement: Concurrent deactivation must not reduce enabled platform administrators to zero.
reconciledFindings.whyCurrentSurfaceCannotClose: workspace-iam has no platform administrator fact or last-admin invariant; creating one there would violate owner sovereignty.

reconciledFindings.requirement: Invitation HTTP/UI readback must expose maskedMobile, never mobileNormalized.
reconciledFindings.whyCurrentSurfaceCanClose: The permitted edge must map the owner readback to generated WorkspaceInvitation so raw mobile is not emitted. The platform-admin feature update is retained only to rename its local field to maskedMobile after the CR02 escape; it is not a CR03 security precondition.

reconciledFindings.requirement: Operations audit must first perform authorized same-scope/context host detail read before owner-local audit read.
reconciledFindings.owner: operations edge plus existing host task readers
reconciledFindings.missingSpecification: The current host task readers accept workspace/key but do not accept or validate assignment/data-scope/page capability; merely invoking them would preserve workspace-only authorization.
reconciledFindings.whyCurrentSurfaceCannotClose: A host-authorization policy/API must be specified before code can honestly reject an in-workspace unauthorized audit request.

reconciledFindings.requirement: Idempotent replay returns the original readback and never appends a second audit event.
reconciledFindings.whyCurrentSurfaceCannotClose: The diagnostic identifies PlatformWorkspaceService replay/audit behavior, but D-4 has already selected organization as the commercial-group audit owner. CR04 must move the writer and prove retained readers/writers before addressing replay; CR03 must not create a temporary platform-workspace patch.

reconciledFindings.requirement: workspace-iam, extension and platform-asset receipts preserve a request fingerprint and the original readback; replay must not append a second audit event.
confirmedFacts: extension.extension_command_receipt retains a nullable legacy definition_id UUID although the later executed alignment migration removed extension_definition.id and made (group_workspace_key, entity_type) canonical.

platform_asset.asset_command_receipt has response_json, while the frozen stage response includes bindGrant; the current design does not specify a replay-safe storage and disclosure treatment for that secret-bearing readback.
All three current edge paths validate Idempotency-Key shape, but the inspected extension and platform-asset owner commands do not yet receive a fingerprint/key or use their receipt tables.
reconciledFindings.whyCurrentSurfaceCannotClose: A correct receipt implementation needs an additive, owner-specific canonical receipt identity and an explicit bind-grant replay treatment. Reusing the stale extension UUID shape or persisting/disclosing a grant without a defined security rule would be an invented persistence contract. U03 explicitly routes schema evolution to U04, so extension/platform-asset receipt closure belongs to CR04.

deferredToR5CRU04: platform-workspace commercial-group audit writer/replay under D-4 organization-owner move
extension durable receipt canonical identity via additive migration
platform-asset durable receipt with non-secret asset facts and fresh one-time bindGrant replay
requiredDesignClarification: Audit host authorization must name the exact page/action and assignment/data-scope predicate for each supported entity type; a workspace-only host lookup is explicitly insufficient.
CR03 audit authorization must use a workspace-iam public task API for assignment/page/action/data-scope and must prohibit organization or edge direct reads of workspace_iam.role_assignment.

CR04 receipt correction must define per-owner canonical receipt identity after the extension JSON alignment and a replay-safe treatment for secret-bearing platform-asset bindGrant; executed migration bytes remain immutable and any schema evolution is additive.
requiredCorrectionShape.codexDecision: Choose the review-recommended split: expand CR03 only for the platform-iam owner fix and the CR02_ESCAPE field-name alignment; defer migration-bound receipts and the D-4 platform-workspace audit move to CR04.
